newsitem.title: USA: Maintenance to close seven Mississippi River locks.
newsitem.headline: Maintenance to close seven Mississippi River locks.

text.p: Seven locks and dams on the Mississippi River will be closed beginning this month and next for scheduled maintenance, which will halt navigation north of those locations, said the Army Corps of Engineers.
- Lock and Dam 11, near Dubuque, Iowa, from December 16 to March 1.
- Lock and Dam 12, near Bellevue, Iowa, from December 24 to March 1.
- Lock and Dam 15, near Rock Island, Ill., from December 24 to March 1.
- Lock and Dam 22, near Hannibal, Mo., from December 26 to February 1.
- Lock and Dam 24, near Bowling Green, Mo., closed daily from 0600 CST to 1800 CST, December 28 to February 1.
- Lock and Dam 25, near Batchtown, Ill., from January 6 to 12.
- Lock and Dam 19, near Keokuk, Iowa, from January 6 to February 1.
